catholic-encyclopedia-1913-edwy:
Edwy, also called Eadwig, was King of the English for a brief, troubled reign, born about 940 and dead in 959. Eldest son of Edmund and Saint Aelfgifu, he was chosen king at fifteen on the death of his uncle Edred and crowned at Kingston in January 956. Young and ill advised, he fell out with Saint Dunstan and Archbishop Odo, taxed his people hard, and stripped his grandmother Eadgive of her lands.

In 957 the Mercians and Northumbrians rose, and his younger brother Edgar took their lead. Beaten at Gloucester, Edwy fled, and the thanes split the land at the Thames, giving the south to Edwy and the north to Edgar. Chastened by defeat, he ruled his share with justice and restraint until his early death. His quarrel with Dunstan over Ethelgive runs through the whole tale.
podcast-dannyjones--TU66IutCWY:
Designer Michael Braun tells Danny Jones how he dressed Jimi Hendrix and Macho Man Randy Savage. Braun created stage clothes for rock gods and ring kings in their wildest eras. His tale threads together music, wrestling, and the craft of making a legend look the part.

Braun shares stories of fittings, tours, and the demands of two very different kinds of star. He explains how a jacket or a robe becomes part of a performer's power. Jones, a fan of both worlds, draws out the best backstage details. Fashion fans and the nostalgic get threads of legend from the man who sewed them.
podcast-dannyjones-KLaHwDZ3HwY:
Filmmaker James Fox joins Danny Jones to discuss a famed alien encounter. Fox has made well-known films about unidentified craft. The sample retells a creature sighting tied to Brazil.

Witnesses describe officers grabbing a strange being with bare hands. The being was taken first to a clinic, per the account. The title claims a toxin that can shut down the immune system. Jones asks how such contact could sicken or kill people. The episode presents witness claims in detail for listeners who follow the UFO field closely. Fox tells the tale as a case still open.
